## User Story

As a native-session operator
I want to retain an accepted WBS child claim when native BUG-to-Epic conversion changes only its canonical prefix because literal title matching currently rejects that legitimate representation
So that I can continue governed decomposition without rewriting accepted plan bytes, losing sibling provenance, or accepting an unrelated child

## Scope

Deliver one standalone correction for a native-converted BUG child whose business title and accepted WBS claim remain unchanged. Literal normalized title equality remains the default. A mismatched title may qualify only through the exact canonical BUG-to-Epic prefix substitution, unchanged nonempty suffix, strict current Epic body kind, and complete current native child/parent repository, node ID and safe positive number facts from the existing provider observations. The readiness subject supplies the expected repository and parent number independently of Plan Metadata.

Production ownership is limited to scripts/task-tracker/lib/decomposition-wbs-coverage.mjs, scripts/task-tracker/lib/decomposition-delivery-readiness.mjs, scripts/task-tracker/lib/decomposition-hook-authority.mjs, scripts/task-tracker/lib/decomposition-authority.mjs, and scripts/gh/lib/wave-admission.mjs. Preserve the untouched provider rawTitle through BOTH collectors while preserving the existing normalized title. Do not let mapSubIssueNodes trimming admit a whitespace variant. Keep all existing provenance, complete-plan-byte, path/section, uniqueness, branch, planning and disposition checks. Add no provider requests, schema field, approval flag, generalized prefix normalization or conversion claim flag.

Bind only facts from actually admitted conversion matches into the local readiness hash, conditionally. Preserve the exact old readiness payload when no such match exists, all ordinary normalized inputs/digests, the serialized epicReadiness child shape, and the project hash in every case. Existing public resume owns assessment refresh and preserves completed publication history; inspection remains read-only. Invalid or stale title, kind, identity and source facts must restrict authority even when another blocker keeps planning=false.

The only configuration change is one exact root-relative .prettierignore entry, /docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-20-2039-active-child-execution-plan.md, with an immutable-source-byte comment. Do not restore or archive that artifact in the live checkout. A disposable formatter fixture must preserve exact J bytes at that path while normal formatting still catches and changes an unformatted sibling and a distinct K archive.

Focused test ownership: scripts/tests/unit/task-tracker/lib/decomposition-plan-exit-gate.test.mjs, decomposition-delivery-readiness.test.mjs, decomposition-authority.test.mjs, decomposition-projection.test.mjs; scripts/tests/unit/task-tracker/gh/lib/wave-admission.test.mjs; scripts/tests/integration/task-tracker/lib/decomposition-hook-traffic.integration.cases.mjs and its existing entry; new scripts/tests/integration/task-tracker/wbs-converted-epic-compatibility.test.mjs; and only necessary extensions to scripts/tests/fixtures/first-child-epic-provider.mjs and first-child-epic-cli-provider.mjs. Reuse genuine registered kind and split/creator/tether paths in disposable physical fixtures with the actual inherited native actor. Native-actor SKIP is not qualification.

Retain an unmodified K ordinary leaf/exact-title assessment byte/hash baseline before implementation. Prove first failing converted-positive and subsequent passing cases, strict negatives and provenance through both collectors, public resume refresh/history preservation and stale-fact invalidation, malformed/pending/unconfirmed cases, exact existing request counts and zero effects in read-only assessment. A full 32-child fixture preserves the 29 closed and two other open sibling claims/states and every independent blocker; a separate fully admissible fixture proves the positive. Do not manufacture whole-parent readiness by marking open siblings done.

Accepted input: Git object 9c91cb69ae285360d6578c0bdf53a42826cbe0da:docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-2071-wbs-title-compatibility-support-plan.md, SHA-256 1c55f67914951c1e8b83c61d771094bc7be23c571a30014e34d5c7b46d1fb0a1. The owning coordinator in chat 01a1a1d9-519c-7db0-b41f-858ad4826d25 accepted independent source/artifact review by /root/review_wbs_compatibility_plan, requested gpt-6-astra/xhigh, with no blocking design findings, and explicitly authorized this defect's governed planning and implementation through native Test/Review handoff. This is relayed SAR design evidence, not a primary XPR/SPR consensus, per-turn model attestation, executed product verification or delivery approval. The separate native B9c91 and Claude74/SPR79 protocol artifacts remain unjoined and unaccepted.

The proposal's 5-6 active engineering hours supports a provisional conservative 6h refinement, including fixtures and independent review. Stop for rescoping if detailed preparation cannot credibly remain within 6h; do not pretend it is a 4h story. The actual assigned issue ID must own its plan filename and commits. Record exact adaptation equivalence and the explicit raw-title clarification; obtain fresh Astra6/xhigh SAR before implementation if the design materially changes.

Fresh preparation on 2026-11-06 found no open duplicate in WBS-title, conversion/title and wbs-provenance-mismatch searches. #1942 has future overlapping migration scope but is Ready for Planning and paused. Open PR #1907 changes the same wave-admission file in separate project-item reader/stage-helper regions; it does not change this correction's child-collector/map regions. No other open PR in the 29-result inventory touches the five production paths. These observations do not transfer another owner's work. Provider trunk remains 2e5a3feec6d6296778f767977cf8086f587d1967, the fresh clean source-worktree base.

This issue has a trunk delivery parent and no native issue parent. It is discovered during #2039 and is a prerequisite correction for #2071; preserve the existing #2071-to-#2145 dependency. Independent final tested-source review, native lifecycle checks and Root's concrete delivery coordination are required before any push, merge, provider callback or Close. Unknown timing remains Unknown.

## Reproduction

Accept a BUG-prefixed child task in a pinned outer WBS plan. Use the existing native kind or split/creator/tether path to represent the same child as an Epic, preserving its business suffix and source claim. The native producers intentionally reconcile the canonical title prefix. Current outer coverage compares the normalized live title literally against the accepted BUG title and reports wbs-provenance-mismatch. The proposed product regression has not yet run; source review established the incompatible contracts.

## Root Cause

Native canonical Epic title reconciliation changes a legitimate converted child's prefix, while decomposition-wbs-coverage requires whole-title equality. Existing collection drops native relationship context and mapSubIssueNodes trims the title, so safe compatibility requires preserving both current normalized behavior and untouched provider rawTitle plus validated native identity through both collectors. Readiness hashing must bind only the facts used to grant this narrow exception so changes cannot leave a stale assessment current.

## Fix Direction

Retain literal comparison first. Add the reviewed exact BUG-to-Epic compatibility predicate using existing strict-kind grammar and prefix constants; transport native root/child context through existing query and fence boundaries; forward expected repository/parent context; conditionally include admitted match facts only in the readiness hash. Preserve ordinary payloads and the project hash. Add the one exact source-byte formatter exception and prove all behavior through genuine disposable producer/collector/refresh fixtures and focused unit tests before normal lifecycle qualification.

## Out of Scope

No live #2039/#2071 kind conversion, graph mutation, sibling change, source repin, source restoration/archive, carrier/trial construction or #2145 activation. No original dirty #2071 checkout reads, frozen f7be changes, reopened #2161, new dependency/schema/approval flag, provider request, sixth production module or unrelated policy change. Preserve original checkouts, refs, ignored evidence and unaccepted review records. No push, merge, provider callback or Close until Root's concrete delivery coordination phase.

- **kind**: code
- **discovered-during**: #2039
- **source**: Independently reviewed WBS compatibility proposal at 9c91cb69ae285360d6578c0bdf53a42826cbe0da; SHA-256 1c55f67914951c1e8b83c61d771094bc7be23c571a30014e34d5c7b46d1fb0a1.
- **authorization**: Root coordinator chat 01a1a1d9-519c-7db0-b41f-858ad4826d25 explicitly accepted the independent Astra6/xhigh design SAR and authorized one standalone defect through native Test/Review handoff under the human's AFK completion delegation.
- **parent**: none; standalone correction with trunk delivery parent, prerequisite for #2071, preserving its existing #2145 dependency.

## Plan Metadata

## Definition of Done
<!--
Each item below MUST be individually verified by running the declared
verifier. Do not bulk-check. Do not preemptively check. The visible checkbox
is the sign-off; the hidden `aitm-dod-evidence:<key>` marker is the evidence
trail. `/task check` refuses to tick a stampable Functional DoD item without
its marker; run `/task dod-stamp <key>` to produce one. The two derived keys
(`acs`, `checkboxes`) are auto-stamped by `/task close` from the body itself.
See `skill/shared/rules/functional-dod.md` for the full contract.

Lifecycle items are verified during Review. Housekeeping items are finalized
during Close; their separate headings make the owning workflow phase explicit.

Kind-aware items (#681): append a `dod:kinds` HTML-comment annotation to scope
an item to a set of issue kinds. `exclude="spike,research"` renders the item for
every kind EXCEPT those listed; `include="code"` renders it only for the listed
kinds; an item with no annotation applies to every kind (the default). The
`tests` item is excluded for the no-code kinds `spike` and `research`, which ship
findings rather than code and would otherwise carry a test-suite DoD item and a
`npm run test:all` verification command they can never satisfy. Filtering happens
at render time in `preflight-issue.mjs`; a filtered-out item is simply absent, so
no phantom evidence marker is ever required for it.

Diff-decides for `docs-only` (#865): the `tests` item deliberately does NOT
static-exclude `docs-only`. A `docs-only` issue can quietly touch code, so the
kind alone must not launder it out of the suite. Instead the `tests` item is
dropped only when the render is `--kind docs-only` AND a supplied
`--changed-paths-file` proves the `trunk...HEAD` diff is documentation-only
(default-deny: any unclassified/empty/mixed diff keeps the item). "The kind
declares, the diff decides."
-->
